simple.summary: פָּרָק (pârâq) means soup (as full of crumbed meat) First listed occurrence: Isa 65 4.

definitions.full: H6564. paraq [ מָּרָק ] noun [masculine] fragment ; — construct מִּגֻּלִים מְּרַק Isa 65:4 Kt, but read מְרַק , see מָרָק .
